verdict.rationale: The evidence implies official client-side SDKs: Adyen says it supports online payments for web, iOS, Android, React Native, and Flutter. It also offers official OpenAPI specs, described as the single source of truth and usable to generate client libraries and to give LLMs context. However, no named server-side SDKs, package names, or SDK docs appear in the pack. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of official server-side SDKs (e.g., Node/Java/Python/.NET libraries), SDK installation and usage docs, and independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK quality.
